queries.query: how strict is attendance in vit vellore

candidates.title: PSA: 75% attendance rule is real, I got debarred from 2 FATs
candidates.content: Every semester people think they can skip and talk to the faculty later. Below 75% you are debarred from the final assessment test for that course, no exceptions unless you have a medical certificate submitted on time through VTOP. Plan your bunks.

Faculty mark attendance every class through VTOP. Some profs are chill about 5 min late, others mark you absent. On-duty for club events gets counted if your coordinator uploads the OD before the deadline.
At VIT-AP the attendance requirement is enforced through the biometric system and the HOD can give condonation for up to 10 percent if you appeal.

candidates.title: How strict is the dress code in Vellore campus?
candidates.content: Do they actually stop you at the gate for wearing shorts or is that just for the academic blocks? Seniors please tell.
Medical leave only counts if you submit the hospital certificate within the window, otherwise it's just absent. Learned that the hard way in second year when I fell below the cutoff.

candidates.title: Best laptop for CSE first year?
candidates.content: Budget is around 70k, mostly coding and some light gaming. Is a MacBook fine for the lab software?

queries.query: branch change cgpa required in vit vellore

candidates.title: Branch change after first year - my experience
candidates.content: I moved from Mech to CSE core. You need a really high GPA after the first two semesters, I had 9.4 and it was barely enough because seats are limited to vacancies. Apply through the academic office form when it opens in May.
The cutoff isn't fixed, it depends on how many students leave each branch. Last year people with 9+ got IT and ECE, CSE needed above 9.5.

candidates.title: What CGPA do companies need for placements?
candidates.content: Most dream companies keep 7.5 or 8 as the cutoff for applying. Is it worth grinding GPA in first year?
In Chennai campus branch change is allowed only within the school, so you can't go from SMEC to SCOPE.
Also note you lose your current seat once the transfer is approved and you have to clear any arrear before you're eligible. No backlogs allowed.

candidates.title: Changing my FFCS slot after registration
candidates.content: I messed up my timetable, can I change a slot after the registration window closes or do I have to drop the course?

queries.query: vit vellore hostel outing rules and curfew

candidates.title: Ladies hostel in-time is 9:30 now, men's blocks 10pm?
candidates.content: New circular says girls have to be back by 9:30 pm and need a leave request on VTOP for night outs. Men's hostel gate closes at 10 pm and late entries get noted by the warden.
For a weekend home outing you apply for leave on VTOP and the proctor approves it. General outing during the day is fine, just scan your ID at the gate.

candidates.title: Which hostel block has the best rooms?
candidates.content: Planning to book for second year, is Q block worth the extra fees over the older blocks? AC vs non AC?
Hostel wifi goes down every night around 1 am and comes back by 6, super annoying during exams.
If you come back after the in-time without a leave approval, your parents get an SMS and repeated violations go to the disciplinary committee.

candidates.title: VIT-AP hostel timings are ridiculous
candidates.content: Amaravati campus hostel closes at 9 pm for everyone and there is no weekend outpass for first years.

queries.query: is vit vellore wifi blocked for sites

candidates.title: Campus network blocks Reddit, Discord and most streaming
candidates.content: The university network filters a lot of sites. Discord, torrent sites and some streaming apps don't load in hostel or academic blocks. GitHub and Stack Overflow work fine.
Most people just use mobile data or a VPN for the blocked stuff. Some VPN protocols get throttled so try a few.

candidates.title: How to register my laptop for the hostel wifi?
candidates.content: I got the login from the hostel office but my laptop's MAC isn't registered. Where do I go?
Jio signal is terrible in the new library, Airtel is better there.
Online gaming servers are restricted on the campus internet, Valorant used to get blocked after 11.

candidates.title: Chennai campus wifi speed
candidates.content: Speeds in the Chennai hostel are around 20 Mbps at night, is it the same at other campuses?

queries.query: how are placements for cse in vit vellore

candidates.title: 2025 placement stats for CSE core
candidates.content: Around 85% of CSE core got placed by March. Median was about 8 LPA, a handful of dream offers above 30 LPA from product companies, mass recruiters took the rest.
Honestly computer science students here do fine if they code. The service companies come in bulk, the good product firms shortlist on CGPA and DSA rounds.

candidates.title: Mechanical placements are dead?
candidates.content: Barely any core mech companies visited this year, most mech students sat for IT roles.
The CSE department building is the new SJT annex, the labs have decent systems.
Internships through the placement cell start in 6th sem and a PPO from one of those is the easiest way into a good company.

candidates.title: VIT-AP CSE placement report
candidates.content: At the Amaravati campus the CSE median this year was around 6 LPA with fewer dream companies.

queries.query: good food spots near vit vellore campus

candidates.title: Underrated places to eat around Katpadi
candidates.content: Try the biryani place near the main gate, the dosa stall at Katpadi junction is cheap and amazing, and there's a decent cafe on the Gandhinagar road for weekends.
Darling Residency's restaurant is good for family dinners when parents visit. A bit pricey but worth it.

candidates.title: Mess food quality has gone down this semester
candidates.content: The special mess caterer changed and the food is way worse. Is anyone else complaining to the mess committee?
Food Street inside campus is open till midnight and has shawarma, maggi and juice, good for late night cravings.

candidates.title: Best food spots near Chennai campus
candidates.content: Kelambakkam has some great places, the Vandalur road dhaba is my favourite.
Spot admissions for the remaining seats happen in July, keep checking the website.

queries.query: cat 1 cat 2 fee difference in vit

candidates.title: Fee categories explained (Cat 1 to Cat 5)
candidates.content: Your VITEEE rank decides the fee category. Cat 1 has the lowest tuition, around 1.98 lakh per year for CSE, and it goes up with each category; Cat 2 is roughly 50k more per year.
Category is fixed for all four years, so getting a better rank saves you a couple of lakhs overall.

candidates.title: CAT 1 exam tips for maths?
candidates.content: Continuous assessment test 1 is next week, what topics usually come for calculus? Any previous papers?
Hostel fees are separate from tuition and depend on the block and AC or non AC.
If you are in a higher category you can still apply for the merit scholarship after first year if you top your branch.

candidates.title: Cat 2 marks out, how do I check?
candidates.content: Where on VTOP are the CAT 2 marks uploaded? I can only see CAT 1.

queries.query: can i get a single room in first year hostel

candidates.title: First year room options - 1 bed AC exists but fills fast
candidates.content: Freshers can pick single, 2, 3, 4 or 6 bedded rooms during hostel booking. Single AC rooms are very limited and go in the first hour, so be online when the portal opens.
I wanted a 1 bed room but only got a 2 bedded non AC. You can request a room change in second semester if beds free up.

candidates.title: Is first year too hard for CSE?
candidates.content: I am scared of the maths courses and programming labs, how much study is needed in the first year?
Room booking order is decided by the date you paid the hostel fee, earlier payment gets an earlier slot.
The single entry pass for the gym is 500 rupees a month.

candidates.title: Day scholar life at VIT
candidates.content: Staying at home in Vellore and commuting daily, bus passes are available from the transport office.
